# openwebui_ollama_connections (Resource)

Manages the list of Ollama backend connections for Open WebUI. This is a singleton resource; the full list is replaced on every apply.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connections` (Attributes List) Ordered list of Ollama connection entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Global toggle for all Ollama connections (`ENABLE_OLLAMA_API`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections`

Required:

- `url` (String) Base URL of the Ollama backend, e.g. `http://localhost:11434`.

Optional:

- `connection_type` (String) Connection type label, e.g. `local`. Stored as-is for model tagging.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether this specific connection is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Optional API key for authenticated Ollama instances. Sensitive.
- `model_ids` (List of String) Allowlist of model names exposed from this connection. Empty list exposes all models.
- `prefix_id` (String) String prepended to every model name from this connection. Empty string disables prefixing.
- `tags` (List of String) Labels attached to models from this connection.
